reconfigure.title: Update Credentials
reconfigure.description: Enter new credentials for your Finder Bliss account.

reauth_confirm.title: Re-authenticate
reauth_confirm.description: Your Finder Bliss credentials are no longer valid. Please enter updated credentials.

error.cannot_connect: Unable to connect to Finder Bliss cloud

set_schedule.name: Set schedule
set_schedule.description: Writes the thermostat's active weekly schedule and switches it to its schedule (AUTO). Temperatures are in °C, rounded to 0.5 and kept between 5 and 20. Nothing is sent if the thermostat already runs this schedule.

blocks.name: Blocks (every day)
blocks.description: One list of time blocks used for all seven days. Each block has from, to (HH:MM) and temp. The first starts at 00:00, each starts where the previous ends, and the last ends at 24:00.

days.name: Blocks per day
days.description: A list of blocks for each of the seven days, keyed mon..sun (or 1..7). Use either this or Blocks, not both.

init.title: BLISS1 manual override
init.description: Duration for BLISS1 temperature changes and manual mode, in hours. Set to 0 for indefinite manual mode. Applies to all BLISS1 thermostats in this account.
